name: tanstack-ui-table
summary: Enhanced React data table component built with shadcn/ui and @tanstack/react-table: sorting, filters, reordering, editing and export.
description: A modular table component with column sorting, column and row reordering, editable cells, row selection, expandable subrows, hideable columns, advanced and simple filter components (dialog and sheet) and PDF/CSV export. Demos include a full-featured table plus sortable-columns and reorderable-rows variants.
contains: enhanced table built with shadcn/ui and @tanstack/react-table
sorting, filtering, column and row reordering
editable cells, selection and expandable subrows
hide columns; PDF and CSV export
advanced and simple filter components in a dialog and a sheet
three demo tables: full featured, sortable columns, reorderable rows
